source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-15: The Blooming Catastrophe

items.name: Vitality Transfer
items.text:
Trigger The leshy crafter would take damage.

---

Effect The leshy crafter uses his mystical link to the Abyssal shard to redirect the damage to a willing leshy of lower level within 30 feet. If this leshy is reduced to 0 HP as a result of the damage, the leshy crafter takes any remaining damage.

items.name: Claws from Below
items.text: The leshy crafter calls spiky roots that shoot up from the ground in the shape of Abyssal claws before retracting an instant later. This ability targets three 5-foot bursts within 30 feet. Each creature on the ground in an affected area takes 2d10 piercing damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save save). A creature takes the same amount of damage no matter how many overlapping bursts it's caught in.

items.name: Leech Materials
items.text:
Frequency once per minute

---

Effect The leshy crafter calls forth materials and natural energies from the surrounding area, creating a brief vortex of flora and debris. Each non-plant creature within 10 feet of the leshy crafter takes 3d6 piercing damage and 3d6 void damage, with a DC 22 basic Fortitude save save.

The debris cloud lasts until the leshy crafter's next turn; while the cloud lasts, all creatures within it become Concealed, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it.
